explication: lwIP is a compact embedded TCP/IP stack. An application sends or receives traffic through the raw or socket APIs; the stack’s transport and IP layers process packets and hand them to network interfaces. The graph also preserves the README’s major protocol and application capabilities. Several internal runtime links are shown as unverified because the sampled excerpts expose headers and source-index references, not their complete call paths.
